newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST-Italy market sees o/n at 6.84 in 3 months.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Italy market sees o/n at 6.84 in 3 months.

text.p: Italy's money market sees interest rate stability on a one month timeframe but a fall under 7.0 percent on a three month horizon, a study based on implicit forward rates by the Bocconi University research arm Igier showed on Friday.

Italy's official discount rate currently stands at 7.50 percent. The implicit overnight rate on a one month timeframe was seen standing at 7.41 percent from 7.71 percent seen one month ago and an actual market rate of 7.81 percent on Thursday, the day on which Igier based its study.
But on a three month timeframe the implicit overnight rate is seen falling to 6.84 percent from 7.26 percent forecast one week ago.

On a one year timeframe the implicit overnight rate is seen falling to 6.06 percent from 6.25 percent seen a week ago. On a two year horizon, the overnight rate is seen at 6.73 percent from 6.54 percent a week ago.

The spread between the Italian implicit overnight rate and the German implicit overnight rate, considered a good indicator of market confidence in European economic and monetary union, is seen at 187 basis points from 181 bps seen a week ago and 237 bps a month ago.
